title: Activity capsule
description: An export collapses into a small persistent capsule without losing its progress.
useCase: Keep one background task available while the rest of an interface stays clear.
interaction: Render, collapse or expand the task, cancel, and restart.
reducedMotion: Expansion and progress segments update immediately; the finite task still runs.
limitations: A bounded local render simulation, not a real export or downloadable artifact.
look: Cool grey page with a dark charcoal rounded card: amber arrow glyph, cream serif filename, beige thumbnail and a row of slate progress segments.
motion: The header toggle shrinks the card to a 230 px pill with a status label (0.25 s ease-out); 24 segments turn amber as a simulated render advances every 500 ms.
adapt: Collapse is the `.capsule[data-expanded=false]` rule (230 px width, 28 px radius) animated by a 0.25 s transition; details fade in with `activity-w2`. Replace the `setTimeout` progress loop and `phase` states with real task events and the file row with your job.
